Karingal Villa Pty. Ltd., trading as Tandoori Patake, is a popular Indian restaurant in Bendigo, Victoria, which was established in 2016. The restaurant is well-known for its authentic food and excellent customer service, attracting both locals and visitors. Over the years, it has become an important part of Bendigo’s dining scene.

Tandoori Patake is not only a great place to eat but also a successful business. Its strong financial performance and ongoing growth show that it can meet customer needs while staying true to its commitment to quality. The restaurant also plays an important role in the local community by creating job opportunities and offering training programs that help people develop valuable skills in hospitality.

As a potential training sponsor, Tandoori Patake offers a great environment for trainees to learn specialised skills in authentic Indian cooking, customer service, and restaurant management. The business has a strong record of helping trainees gain practical, hands-on experience with support from skilled professionals. This focus on training contributes to building a skilled workforce in Australia, with individuals who are ready to meet the demands of the hospitality industry.

The restaurant blends traditional values with modern practices, using technology such as online booking systems and efficient kitchen workflows to improve service and streamline operations. This mix of tradition and modernity helps the business grow and creates an ideal learning space for trainees to develop their skills.

In summary, Karingal Villa Pty. Ltd. is ready to be a training provider, offering a supportive and structured learning environment. The business’s commitment to excellence in both its operations and training ensures that trainees gain the skills and knowledge they need to grow in their careers in hospitality.

Key Responsibilities:

•	 Plan, prepare, and cook a diverse range of Indian cuisine, including tandoori specialities, curries, biryanis, Indo-Chinese dishes, traditional Indian desserts, and regional delicacies while maintaining consistent quality and presentation standards.
•	Conduct regular stock checks, monitor inventory levels, and ensure efficient utilisation of ingredients to minimise wastage and support daily kitchen requirements.
•	Prepare, portion, and cut vegetables, meats, and other ingredients prior to service to facilitate smooth and timely kitchen operations.
•	Manage the ordering, receiving, inspection, and storage of food supplies in accordance with food safety, hygiene, and quality control standards.
•	Operate and maintain various commercial kitchen equipment, including ovens, grills, tandoors, flat-top grills, and microwaves, while following established cooking procedures and safety protocols.
•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety regulations, maintaining a clean, organised, and hygienic kitchen environment at all times.
•	Supervise, train, and support kitchen staff by allocating tasks, monitoring performance, and ensuring efficient workflow during service periods.
•	Prepare staff rosters, coordinate work schedules, assign responsibilities, and assist with wage allocation based on operational requirements.
•	Collaborate with Managers, Dietitians, and kitchen team members regarding menu planning, meal preparation processes, and specific dietary requirements.
•	Prepare authentic Indian snacks, including samosas, chaat, puri, and other traditional street-food items while maintaining authenticity and quality.
•	Prepare a variety of Indian sauces, accompaniments, soups, marinades, and speciality ingredients to support menu requirements.
•	Maintain consistency in food quality, presentation, portion control, and flavour across all dishes to ensure customer satisfaction.

To be successful in this role, you must have:
•	Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery or equivalent as a minimum qualification. 
•	Proven experience in preparing authentic Indian vegetarian and non-vegetarian cuisine, including tandoori breads and specialty dishes. 
•	Creativity and passion for Indian food with the ability to maintain consistency in quality and presentation. 
•	Strong time management skills and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment. 
•	A thorough understanding of OH&S and Food Safety regulations. 
•	High standards of personal presentation and kitchen cleanliness. 
•	Flexibility to work across days, nights, weekends, split shifts, and public holidays as required.

Front End Developer (also known as Front End Engineer, Web Developer, Front End Software Developer, Software Developer, CSS Developer, HTML Developer, Programmer, Software Engineer)
The purpose of the Front End Developer is to be a hands-on developer working in a cross discipline team to deliver the front-end portion of websites & web applications. Collaborating with other engineers (front-end & back-end), creatives, and clients, the front-end developer may implement web experiences via working in front-end workflows within a project team of technical & non-technical members to help drive business outcomes for our clients.
Working closely with UX designers to translate wireframes, this role also requires maintenance & management of frontend libraries alongside the building, testing & deployment of code.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Worked in software engineering roles focussed on front-end development for 4+ years.

?	Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

Senior Front End Developer
We are on the hunt for a Senior Front End Developer to be a hands-on developer working with cross discipline teams to deliver the front-end portion of websites & web applications. Leading a team of engineers (front-end & back-end) while working closely with other creative teams and clients, the Senior Front-End Developer is responsible for building & maintaining various features as per clients’ requirements. This may include the implementation of web experiences via working in front-end workflows within a project team of technical & non-technical members to help drive business outcomes for our clients.
Working closely with UX designers to translate wireframes, this role also requires maintenance & management of frontend libraries alongside the building, testing & deployment of code.

?	Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Salary – Over threshold


Back End Developer (also known as Web Developer, Software Engineer, Programmer, Software Developer, Back-End Software engineer)
The Back End Developer is an analytical, goal-oriented person who will work with team members to troubleshoot and improve existing back-end applications and processes. Using their understanding of programming languages and tools, the Back End Developer will analyze current codes and industry developments, formulate more efficient processes & solve problems, to create a more seamless experience for users. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication, computer, and project management skills.
The role will involve: compiling and analysing data, processes, and codes to troubleshoot problems and identify areas for improvement, collaborating with the front-end developers and other team members to establish objectives and enable the design to be more functional, implementing cohesive codes where necessary to enhance the user experience. The back end developer will also be responsible for developing ideas for new programs, features or products via research & monitoring of industry trends.
To succeed as a backend developer, you should be focused on building a better, more efficient program and creating a better end-user experience. You should be knowledgeable, collaborative, and motivated. The ideal candidate will have relevant tertiary qualification in computer programming, computer science or a related field; or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification, but also ideally have a minimum of 2 years experience in a similar role. Fluency or understanding of specific languages, such as Java, PHP, or Python, and operating systems may be required. The candidate will also have a strong understanding of the web development cycle and programming techniques and tools; be focused on efficiency, user experience, and process improvement and also have excellent project and time management skills.
Salary – Over threshold
